core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abraha is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Year of the Elephant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abraha corresponds to the Arabic form أبرهة (أ ب ر ه). Its core sense is father of ishmael (abraha). Abraha (أبرهة) was an Aksumite viceroy of Himyar in 6th-century Yemen, remembered in Islamic tradition for the failed campaign against Mecca in the 'Year of the Elephant' (c. 570 CE), the traditional context of Sūrat al-Fīl. The source record's gloss 'Father of Ishmael' is unsupported.
